invariant_id: Corrected Rule cost units (A1 F-001); realized-risk
summary: Cost-unit seam (rate from modeled_costs_per_unit vs quote/unit in size_position) has no oracle; the only joining test recomputes the buggy formula; golden input yields SL loss 103.59 vs allowed risk 50 unasserted.
expected: Property test: SL-exit realized loss <= allowed risk (+ tolerance) and sizing realized_risk ~= simulated SL loss incl. fees; producer returns quote/unit scaling with price.
actual: Test 11 asserts sim_costs == fee_in+fee_out+slippage (same formula); Test 4 asserts only realized==gross-fees-slippage; phase5 fixtures feed '1.0'/'0.0' quote values and never call the producer.
impact: Money-critical 1R-per-stop invariant unprotected; F-001 passed 1268 tests and verification; P11 fix can regress silently.
evidence: probe_fee.py on phase6/intrabar_both_touched: modeled_costs_per_unit 0.0008, qty 635.67, realized_risk 49.99998, entry_fee 15.45, exit_fee 38.59, realized_pnl -103.594 (allowed 50); SHORT -106.76. phase5 happy_path_long modeled_costs_per_unit '1.0' at BTC 50k.
why_tests_miss: Tautological oracle; fixtures bypass producer; no cross-module property.
recommendation: Add SL-loss-vs-budget property over simulator fixtures; hand-computed oracle for costs; realistic per-unit costs in phase5 fixtures.
known_prior: KNOWN defect F-001/F-109/ROADMAP P11; test-mechanism analysis new

summary: Simulator tests lack causality/exit-structure oracles; fixture generator places fill/exit 1m data inside the signal bar; 7 of 9 phase6 cases have no expected.json (_load_expected dead); lookahead suites test strategy.evaluate only; paper parity projects to (signal_id, reason_code); TP2 never compared.
expected: Per-record invariants signal_close < entry_time <= exit_time; hand-verified expected outputs; negative fixture (signal-bar touch only => no fill); backtest-vs-live exit-structure (TP1/TP2) parity or explicit pinned deviation.
actual: Coarse label assertions only; exit_time 09:00:59 precedes entry 09:59:59 on golden fixture with all tests green; no TP2 comparison.
impact: Kill-gate/family-selection evidence can be structurally invalid with a green suite; fixes to F-901/F-102 have no driving or regression tests.
evidence: gen_phase6_fixtures.py docstring 'The last 1H bar is the trigger bar ... 1m intrabar data resolves the exit'; intrabar keyed by _trigger_bar_close_key; only registry_identity and report_slices have expected.json; baselines/simple_trend/expected.json {trades: [], trade_count: 1} unused; test_paper_parity docstring 'paper loop does not simulate fills yet'.
reproduction: probe_fee.py prints entry_time/exit_time for golden fixture.
why_tests_miss: No temporal-ordering oracle; prefix invariance cannot detect use of pre-decision data; no golden outputs.
recommendation: Shared trade-record validator with temporal invariants; commit and compare hand-verified expected.json; regenerate fixtures with 1m data in bars N+1..; extend parity to fills/exits.
known_prior: KNOWN defects F-120/F-901/F-102; corrects F-901 claim that golden fixtures pin byte-for-byte

recommendation: List these tests as 'to invert' in the fix phases; annotate now with F-952/F-953 references.
known_prior: KNOWN defects F-952/F-105/F-953/09 WR-07; entrenchment new; root cause plan F-952/F-953, doc F-009

invariant_id: migrations; SAFE_MODE persistence (F-127); approval conditional update
summary: PG tests skipped and use create_all (migrations never applied to a DB); migration parity is offline column-name comparison; unique constraints checked by grep; no restart/rehydration test exists for SAFE_MODE/enablement/kill gate.
expected: Throwaway-PG job with alembic upgrade head + PG tests; restart tests reconstructing controllers from journal; conditional-update approval-store test.
actual: 6 PG skips in every recorded run; grep for restart/rehydrat in relevant tests returns nothing.
impact: Migration/constraint drift and loss of SAFE_MODE/disabled state across restart undetected until live.
evidence: skipif(not TEST_DATABASE_URL) + Base.metadata.create_all(engine); check_migration_parity output 'Generating static SQL' and column lists only; test_wr30 asserts 'unique=True' in migration text.
why_tests_miss: PG optional; create_all bypasses migrations; no restart tests.
recommendation: Compose PG test target, alembic upgrade/downgrade smoke, journal rehydration tests.

summary: Paper WS fakes are sync while SDK kline_candlestick_streams is async and not contract-bound (unlike execution fakes' _bind_real), letting the missing await (F-125) pass.
expected: Contract test asserting coroutine-function and signature parity between fakes and SDK methods.
actual: Sync fake returns a handle; real call returns an un-awaited coroutine.
impact: Paper feed never delivers klines once composed; forward evidence silently empty.
evidence: Fake 'def kline_candlestick_streams(self, *, symbol, interval, id=None)'; SDK websocket_streams.py:430 'async def kline_candlestick_streams('; src/adapters/paper_ws.py:160 call without await.
why_tests_miss: Fake not bound to SDK contract.
recommendation: SDK-bound fake contract tests for all adapter-used SDK methods.
